log_care.name: Log care
log_care.description: Logs care for Smart Plants plants or marks care tasks as done. Logging watering also keeps Needs water off for 24 hours.

kind.name: Care type
kind.description: What was done. Required when you target plants. When you target a care task, it can be left empty; if set, it must match the task.

occurred_at.name: Time
occurred_at.description: When the care happened. Defaults to now and cannot be in the future.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note, up to 500 characters. Required for the Note care type.

skip_care_task.name: Skip care task
skip_care_task.description: Skips the current occurrence of Smart Plants care tasks. The task becomes due again on its next scheduled date. Care tasks that follow a sensor reading cannot be skipped.

snooze.name: Snooze alerts
snooze.description: Snoozes the alerts of Smart Plants plants, for example during a vacation. Entities keep their real states; their Snoozed attribute turns on so automations can stay quiet. Snoozing again replaces the end. The snooze ends by itself.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to snooze, counted from now. Set either this or Until, at most 366 days.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the snooze ends. Set either this or Duration, at most 366 days ahead.

unsnooze.name: Resume alerts
unsnooze.description: Ends the alert snooze of Smart Plants plants now.

get_report.name: Get plant report
get_report.description: Returns which plants need water, have problems or have care tasks due, with a ready-to-send title and message. Paused plants are left out.

include.name: Include
include.description: What the report lists. Problems are all problems except needs water.

include_snoozed.name: Include snoozed plants
include_snoozed.description: Also list plants whose alerts are snoozed, marked as snoozed.

unsupported_target.message: Choose plants or care tasks directly. Areas, floors, and labels are not supported.

reading_task_skip.message: {target} follows a sensor reading and cannot be skipped. Mark it as done instead.

needs_water.name: Plant needs water
needs_water.description: Triggers when one or more plants start to need water. Snoozed plants trigger when the snooze ends. Without a target, it watches all plants.

include_snoozed.description: Also trigger while the plant is snoozed. The end of the snooze then does not trigger again.

problem_started.name: Plant problem started
problem_started.description: Triggers when a plant problem starts, for example too wet or too little light.

include_snoozed.name: Also while snoozed
include_snoozed.description: Also trigger while the plant is snoozed. The end of the snooze then does not trigger again.

problem_cleared.name: Plant problem cleared
problem_cleared.description: Triggers when a plant problem is over.

care_task_due.description: Triggers when a care task of a plant becomes due.
